explainBack: Volunteers followed recurring names, phrases and links into other public pages. Those matches create leads, while dates, revision history and independent attribution decide how strong each claim is.
unseenTransfer: For a screenshot said to show a government chatbot leaking data, locate the original page, determine when the text appeared and look for independent confirmation of which system produced it before repeating the claim.
